question: Does a 10-year persistence profile beat our single 2025 year?
why_restricted: The decade profile exists for only 1.37% of our cells and that subset is 87.4% positive vs 0.099% elsewhere. Adding these columns to the full table would let the model read the label off feature missingness. This experiment therefore runs only where every row has the profile.
cannot_self_compute: Our FIRMS archive is 2025 only, and NOAA-20 launched in November 2017, so a decade of NOAA-20 data does not exist. The IHS profile came from Suomi-NPP.
headline_metric: ROC-AUC (subset is 94.8% positive, so PR-AUC is uninformative)
verdict: WORTH IT - request a multi-year Suomi-NPP archive from FIRMS and rebuild these features for all 687,289 cells.
